title: Proof
body_md:
Spin-$j$ zero-eigenvalues of $\widetilde{\cal D}_\infty$ only occur if there exists fermions with weight $\mu\in \Delta_{R_{A,s_I}}$ that have quantum number $n=|\langle \mu,T_3-I_3\rangle|-\frac{1}{2}>0.$ These only exist if $j+s_I\geq |\langle \mu,T_3-I_3\rangle|-\frac{1}{2}\geq |j-s_I|$ where $v_\mu$  belongs to some irreducible ${\vec{I}}^{(i,a)}$-component of spin-$s_I$.                                                                                                                                                                                     
Now, using the fact that $|\langle \mu,T_3-I_3\rangle|\leq q_{R_A}-s_I,$ $\forall \mu \in \Delta_{R_{A,s_I}}$and the fact that $j\geq q_{R_A}+\frac{1}{2}>s_I$ we see that 
\begin{align}\begin{split}
j-s_I\geq q_{R_A}-s_I+\frac{1}{2} >| \langle \mu,T_3-I_3\rangle|-\frac{1}{2} \quad, \quad \forall \mu \in \Delta_{R_{A,s_I}}~,
\end{split}\end{align}
and 
therefore there are no zero-eigenvectors of $\widetilde{\cal D}_\infty$ when $j>q_{R_A},s_I$. \qed
